content:
The Closing Session on Contaminated Soils and Rocks took place on 12 December, marking the end of the initiatives carried out following the protocol that BUILT CoLAB established with APA and the Environmental Fund as part of the ‘Soil Quality Assessment’ project.

This session presented the results and took stock of the Cycle of Training Actions that BUILT CoLAB organised, as well as the media kit developed as part of the project, and addressed the relevance of the topic and this type of initiative, with contributions from the participants.

You can view or review the content shared, as well as the Media Kit, on the project website available at 👉 https://builtcolab.pt/solos-rochas-contaminados/
